rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Tangaroa, Tangaroa-whakamau-tai, the Māori sea atua depicted in whale form. Native square PNG at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: a living whale, one head, two eyes, two pectoral flippers and a broad horizontal tail; natural whale form with no humanoid parts, jewellery or invented tattoo motifs [tangaroa-c02]
MOMENT: RISE from the tide toward the viewer as the tidal surge lifts around its immense close-framed head; benevolent but overwhelming, not a monster
POWER: the tide forms a powerful rising wall physically curling around the whale under its documented tidal authority, water and spray only [tangaroa-c02]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, tight foreshortened framing; no invented gigantic size
LIGHT & WEATHER: single amber sunset seam lighting crest and wet whale, ocean shadows almost black
SURFACE: wet slate-grey whale skin, heavy water sheets and spray
SETTING: open sea, Tangaroa maritime realm [tangaroa-c01]
MOOD: imposing and awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the documented character; never cute, calm or decorative. The creature itself dominates and remains striking at 200 pixels.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, coloured magic mist or energy ribbons. Bracketed claim IDs are instructions, never visible text.
depicted_variant: Tangaroa-whakamau-tai in documented whale form, controlling tides.
aura: Reverent awe comes from whale manifestation amid its moving tide (tangaroa-c02).
artistic_choices: Natural unspeciated whale body is editorial; no species identification asserted. Framing rather than miniature boats creates scale. Respectful awe for a living tradition; no menace toward people.

visual_review.notes: Viewed native and 200px. All seven checks pass: overwhelming whale head and two natural flippers emerging in moving tidal walls; nonmonstrous reverent whale form c02. Wet skin and physical spray remain forceful at thumbnail scale. Whale fills frame; no human anatomy or added symbols; no glow or beams. Tail and far eye occluded by angle/water, not multiplied.
